entries.subject: backend-api: bounded 429/503 retry for idempotent GETs
entries.body:
GET-only resilience in backendApiRequest: max 2 retries (3 attempts
total) on 429/503 with exponential backoff (250ms base) plus jitter,
capped at 4000ms; Retry-After honored in delay-seconds and HTTP-date
forms (fail fast when it exceeds the cap so handlers never pin). The
per-attempt timeout signal is created fresh so retries get the full
budget. POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE keep exactly one attempt (replay could
double-apply a mutation); network failures are not retried.

  kill a scan BEFORE the 8s server-side statement_timeout it is
  budgeted for. Raised to maxWait 10s / timeout 12s so the server-side
  statement_timeout stays the real per-scan budget; safeQuery (15s)

entries.subject: Revert "queries/pnl: fix windowed/daily/bounded P&L over-counting upgrader house gains"
entries.body:
This reverts commit ea5e97b89a39a1d958e0dd67f1c58912b1218b2f, restoring the
prior owner-confirmed-correct Daily / windowed / bounded house P&L.

ea5e97b8 added `+ upgrader_games.won_amount` into the balanceChange term of
the windowed-delta P&L (calculateWindowedPnl, getDailyPnl,
calculateUsersBoundedWindowedPnlBatch, getPnlBreakdownWindows,
getUserWindowedPnlMulti). That made the Dashboard's 30-day Daily P&L render
as a near-uniform all-loss, which is false.

Root cause (proven read-only against prod, 2026-06-11/12): the upgrader WIN
is NOT a missing ledger credit -- it is delivered as an INVENTORY ITEM.
upgrader_games.awarded_inventory_item_id is set on 20,326/20,326 winning
games (30d); the awarded items' value_at_obtained sums to $1,477,922, matching
won_amount $1,478,061 (0 vouchers, 0 upgrader_payout ledger rows). So the win
is already fully captured by the formula's inventoryChange (obtained) leg, and
the bet debit is already in balanceChange (raw SUM(balance_after -
balance_before), not a type whitelist). Adding +won to balanceChange was a
THIRD counting of the same win -- it double-subtracted ~$1.38M of upgrader
wins over 30 days as phantom house loss. The commit's premise ("ledger misses
the win credit") was right that the win is off-ledger, but wrong that it was
uncounted: it lands in inventory, not balance.

Restoring the pre-ea5e97b8 form (which counts the win exactly once, via
inventoryChange) brings Daily P&L back to a realistic profit/loss mix (probe:
9 of 13 recent days house-profit vs 1 of 13 under ea5e97b8).

Scope: only src/lib/queries/pnl.ts + src/lib/queries/users-windowed-pnl.ts
(the exact two files ea5e97b8 touched). 707692b6 (ledger-set classification)
is unaffected and stays.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

entries.subject: queries/pnl: fix windowed/daily/bounded P&L over-counting upgrader house gains
entries.body:
PROVEN on the new prod DB (read-only, 2026-06-11): the upgrader WIN credit
is written OFF-LEDGER into upgrader_games.won_amount -- there are ZERO
upgrader_payout ledger rows (vs 72,916 upgrader_bet debits). So a
balanceChange = SUM(balance_after - balance_before) over completed ledger
rows carries ONLY the upgrader_bet DEBIT and MISSES every upgrader win
credit. Every windowed/daily/bounded P&L (pnl = deposits - withdrawals -
balanceChange - inventoryChange - voucherChange) therefore OVERSTATED house
profit by ~the upgrader win volume (~$1.38M lifetime; ~$5.1k rolling-24h).

Fix: re-introduce an upgrader win-credit correction sourced from
upgrader_games.won_amount, bucketed by upgrader_games.created_at into the
SAME window/day buckets and folded into balanceChange (a user win is a
house loss). Mirrors exactly how queries.ts upgraderMetrics /
getDailyGamingMetrics and dashboard.ts cachedDailyUpgrader already source
upgrader: won_amount column, created_at bucket, wholesale-creator-drop
real-customer scope for the GLOBAL cohort (creator upgrader is house-funded),
just the id for a single user/per-id batch, and a to_regclass table-existence
PROBE that gates the read so a pre-upgrader DB degrades to 0 instead of
throwing 42P01 (the inline to_regclass WHERE does not prevent the parse-time
42P01, confirmed, so the read is gated on a separate probe like the
canonical readers).

Edit sites (all the windowed/delta forms; lifetime snapshot P&L is correct
and untouched):
  - pnl.ts calculateWindowedPnl
  - pnl.ts getDailyPnl (per-day fold)
  - pnl.ts calculateUsersBoundedWindowedPnlBatch (per-user [start,end) batch)
  - pnl.ts getPnlBreakdownWindows (3-window; also wires the informational
    upgraderPayouts row off upgrader_games.won_amount since the
    upgrader_payout ledger credit it used to read is always 0 -- it sits
    inside the corrected balanceDelta so the "payouts subset of balanceDelta"
    invariant holds)
  - users-windowed-pnl.ts getUserWindowedPnlMulti (per-window single-user
    rolling ladder)

calculateUserPnl / calculateUsersPnlBatch (lifetime, balances+inventory+
vouchers snapshot, NOT ledger deltas) and getPackBattlePurePnl are correct
and left untouched. The now-false "ledger carries both legs / stale
assumption" comments are replaced with the prod-verified reality.

Decimal-safe (won_amount::numeric summed in SQL, ::text out, toNumber);
cache keys + safeQuery/withTiming wrappers unchanged; house-POV colors
unchanged; no function props across the RSC boundary (all returns numbers).
Verified read-only against prod: rolling-24h correction = $5,113.86 (matches
spec ~$5,106.80); lifetime won = $1,380,509.35 (~$1.38M).

entries.body:
No admin except the owner `motha` may see ANY admin balance adjustment on
a user. Enforced server-side at the single query chokepoint
(getUserTransactions) so the admin_balance_adjustment ledger rows are never
sent to the client for a non-owner viewer — across every surface: the
dedicated adjustments block, the Deposits & Withdrawals feed, the Recent
Activity timeline, the transaction-detail modal, and the paginated/filtered
re-fetch via fetchUserTransactions.

- New server-only helper isAdjustmentVisibilityOwner (username === "motha",
  case-insensitive, active, fail-closed), matching the existing founder
  identity convention. Narrower than the salary founder allowlist.
- getUserTransactions resolves the viewer via cached verifySession and ANDs
  a `type != admin_balance_adjustment` exclusion into the where for
  non-owners, so both rows and count omit adjustments. The legacy
  motha-only-profile carve-out now applies only to the owner viewer.
- Defence-in-depth UI: the dedicated adjustments block is owner-gated and
  the Finances type-filter drops the adjustment option for non-owners
  (the server already returns zero such rows). Owner (motha) sees
  everything exactly as before.
